title: Wild Animals
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion is a big cat with a long tail. Lions sleep for many hours every day.

Wolves live in forests and mountains. They hunt in packs. Wolves are very good at running. At night, you can hear them howl.

questions.text: What do wolves do at night?
Why do wolves hunt in packs?
options: Because they are afraid of the dark
Because it helps them catch food
Because they like to sleep together

questions.text: What kind of animal is a lion probably?

vocabulary.definition: groups of lions that live together
the long part at the back of an animal's body
groups of animals that hunt together
to make a long, loud cry

paragraph_translations: Los leones viven en África. Viven en grupos llamados manadas. Un león es un gato grande con una cola larga. Los leones duermen muchas horas cada día.
Los lobos viven en bosques y montañas. Cazan en manadas. Los lobos son muy buenos corriendo. De noche, puedes oírlos aullar.
